title: Fixed-order ROABP PIT reduces to noncommutative ABP PIT
field: Any field F; F_2 gives unit-cost bit arithmetic

output_interface: Same graph with homogeneous labels a_e*x_0+b_e*x_i interpreted in F<x_0,...,x_n>; white-box NC-ABP PIT
theorem: The commutative output p is zero iff the free-algebra lift is zero.
cost: Same vertices and edges; deterministic poly(S,n) field operations from Raz-Shpilka NC-ABP PIT; poly(S,n) bit time over F_2; no blow-up matrix dimension.
falsifier: A fixed-order input whose distinct layer-choice subsets collide as free words or homogenized commutative monomials.

title: Abelianization does not preserve identity for arbitrary ABP lifts
input_model: Two-path commutative ABP with paths xy and -yx
theorem: p=xy-yx=0 in F[x,y], but q=xy-yx is nonzero in F<x,y>; q(E_12,E_21) is invertible in M_2(F).
cost: Constant-size ABP; exact d=2 witness, evaluated matrix order 2.
falsifier: None for the stated algebraic example; this refutes only the same-path lift, not all possible reductions.
unresolved: No general lower bound against other representations

title: ABP determinant pencil has full size-2 blow-up rank in both PIT cases
input_model: Commutative ABP p, free path lift q, DAG with path polynomial qz+ab-ba
output_interface: Affine pencil L=[[I-U,e_t],[e_s^T,0]], where U is strictly upper-triangular weighted adjacency
theorem: For m DAG vertices, det_comm(L)=-zp, so commutative rank is m+1 iff p!=0 and m iff p=0. Yet the d=2 substitution x_i=z=0, a=E_12, b=E_21 gives rank 2(m+1) for every p.
cost: Pencil order m+1; blow-up parameter d=2; evaluated order 2(m+1); O(m+|E|) block operations for sparse witness, O(m^2) entries if densely materialized.
falsifier: Find a singular evaluated pencil under the stated matrix-unit assignment and branch construction.
unresolved: Obstructs only this determinant/rank transfer gadget
